261-1981-2415-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2415-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

69-539-2872-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-2872-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-2872-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

483-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
483-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Cruel Celebrant triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

2586-4186-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat
2586-4186-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4210-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
4210-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

34-141-2511.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-2511.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-728-1070.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-728-1070.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

240-4247-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2557-3129-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

215-3291-6968.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-6968.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1563-4742-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-4742-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-4742-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

413-2906-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
413-2906-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

4907-5330-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
4907-5330-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

465-2034-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-2034-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

2034-2350-4871-5497-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Stone Calendar.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4324-4552-6753.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6747-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1978-2750-3784.description:
Cause Vhal to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more charge counters on it

198-4067-5801-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {B} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Mind Peel with buyback by paying {2}{B}{B}{B}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +5/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Mind Peel.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

1741-2092-4013.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {C} if Agatha has power 2 or greater, or {1}{C} otherwise.
1741-2092-4013.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying at most {1}{C}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.
1741-2092-4013.notes: If Agatha has power 2 or greater, you'll only pay {C} in step 2 and can net mana from the second land.

3284-4050-4871-5010.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {1}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
If desired, you may instead use Golgari Thug's dredge ability to return it to your hand to mill your library.

3859-4094-5554.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
3859-4094-5554.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double all tokens you create this turn.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {U}{B}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{B}.
Repeat from step 2.

2812-5058.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature on the battlefield with toughness equal to 1.
2812-5058.description:
Cast Screams from Within by paying {1}{B}{B}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Knight of Doves and Screams from Within.
Resolve the Knight of Doves trigger, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Resolve the Screams from Within trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Bird.
Repeat from step 2.

177-2034-3867-4231-5032.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Treats to Share from the top of your library by paying {G}.
Gorion triggers, copying Treats to Share.
Resolve both Treats to Share, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens, and exiling Treats to Share.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Curious Pair from exile by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

112-565-4705.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
112-565-4705.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Harmonic Prodigy.
Orvar triggers twice and Harmonic Prodigy triggers once.
Resolve the Harmonic Prodigy trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Orvar triggers, creating two token copies of Harmonic Prodigy.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Harmonic Prodigy.
Orvar triggers four times, and each Harmoic Prodigy triggers three times.
Resolve all Harmonic Prodigy triggers, giving each Harmonic Prodigy +3/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve all Orvar triggers, creating four token copies of Harmonic Prodigy.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting any nonlegendary permanent you control that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Orvar triggers eight times, and each Harmonic Prodigy triggers seven times.
Resolve all Harmonic Prodigy triggers, giving each Harmonic Prodigy +7/+7 until end of turn.
Resolve all Orvar triggers, creating eight copies of the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Activate four of the copies of the mana-producing permanent by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 11.

654-774-3478.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

186-1409-2690-3280-4208.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, creating a token copy of Deadeye Navigator that is a 1/1 green Frog.
The Deadeye Navigator token enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability, pairing it and Ixidron.
Activate Ixidron by paying {U}, blinking it.
All other nontoken creatures you control are turned face-down as Ixidron enters the battlefield.
Ixidron enters the battlefield, triggering the token Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing Ixidron and the token Deadeye Navigator.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {1}, turning it face up.
Rattleclaw Mystic triggers, adding {G}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1346-1357-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1346-1357-4821.description:
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Repeated Reverberation by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to create two copies of the next instant spell you cast this turn.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Repeated Reverberation triggers, creating two copies of Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve a copy of Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Dramatic Reversal copy.
Repeat from step 5.

776-1329-4534-4671.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-4534-4671.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Accorder's Shield to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Accorder's Shield.
Cast Accorder's Shield.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

381-2452-4050-4311.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gravebane Zombie, adding one mana of any color.
Gravebone Zombie is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard.
Cast Gravebane Zombie from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1089-1525-4298-4651.notablePrerequisites:
Phyresis and Curiosity attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
1089-1525-4298-4651.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

1518-1987-3277-3448.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-3277-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
